definitions.gloss: company cafeteria; staff canteen; office cafeteria
definitions.explanation: An in-house dining facility at a company, where employees can buy meals at subsidized prices. Used both for the cafeteria itself and for the meals served there.

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}は{社食|しゃしょく}で{食|た}べる。
examples.english: I eat lunch at the company cafeteria.

examples.japanese: {社食|しゃしょく}のメニューが{毎日|まいにち}{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The cafeteria menu changes every day.

examples.japanese: うちの{社食|しゃしょく}は{安|やす}くて{栄養|えいよう}バランスもいいので、ほぼ{毎日|まいにち}{利用|りよう}している。
examples.english: Our company cafeteria is cheap and nutritionally balanced, so I use it almost every day.

notes:
Casual abbreviation of {社員|しゃいん}{食堂|しょくどう} (employee cafeteria). Common in spoken language and informal writing; the full form is preferred in formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社食|しゃしょく}で{食|た}べる: to eat at the company cafeteria
- {社食|しゃしょく}の{定食|ていしょく}: cafeteria set meal
- {社食|しゃしょく}{利用|りよう}{券|けん}: cafeteria meal ticket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {社員|しゃいん}{食堂|しょくどう}: employee cafeteria (full form)
- {学食|がくしょく}: university cafeteria (same abbreviation pattern)
- {食堂|しょくどう}: cafeteria; canteen (general term)
